changelog: 👁️ Phase 6 Upgrade: Real-Time Inotify File Watcher & WebSocket Event Bus in `agy_ide_bridge_rs`.
⚡ Instant Disk Sync: Native Linux inotify watches active workspace files and pushes debounced `fs_event` notifications over `/ws`.
🔄 Automatic IDE Tab & Explorer Reload: Open tabs automatically reload when files are modified externally; new files instantly appear in the explorer without polling.
